questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Henry only started learning English last year. However, he can now speak it like a native.
options: A. If he had started learning English last year, Henry could now speak it like a native.
B. After starting learning English last year, Henry can now speak it like a native.
C. Although he only started learning English last year, Henry can now speak it like a native.
D. Henry, who has only started learning English since last year, can now speak it like a native.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Hai mệnh đề thể hiện sự tương phản dùng Although để nối. Dịch nghĩa: Mặc dù chỉ mới bắt đầu học tiếng Anh vào năm ngoái, nhưng giờ đây Henry đã có thể nói tiếng Anh như người bản xứ.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Our school started building a new canteen in June. They are still building it now.
options: A. Our school have started building a new canteen from June till now.
B. Our school have been building a new canteen since June.
C. Our school have built a new canteen now since starting in June.
D. Our school are building the new canteen which started in June.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Diễn tả hành động bắt đầu trong quá khứ và vẫn đang tiếp diễn → dùng thì Present Perfect Continuous (have/has been + V-ing). Dịch nghĩa: Trường của chúng tôi đã xây dựng căn tin mới từ tháng Sáu đến nay.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. The teacher was giving the lesson. The lights went out.
options: A. The lights went out as soon as the teacher started giving the lesson.
B. If the teacher had been giving the lesson, the lights wouldn't have gone out.
C. The teacher was giving the lesson, so the lights went out.
D. While the teacher was giving the lesson, the lights went out.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: “While + Past Continuous, Past Simple” → diễn tả một hành động đang xảy ra thì hành động khác xen vào. Dịch nghĩa: Khi cô giáo đang giảng bài thì đèn tắt.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. We have been trying to learn English for years. We haven't succeeded yet.
options: A. Although we have been trying to learn English for years, we haven't succeeded yet.
B. After we've been trying to learn English for years, we have succeeded.
C. We haven't succeeded yet since we have been trying to learn English for years.
D. We have been trying to learn English for years, so we haven't succeeded yet.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Hai mệnh đề mang ý tương phản dùng Although để nối. Dịch nghĩa: Mặc dù chúng tôi đã cố gắng học tiếng Anh trong nhiều năm, nhưng vẫn chưa thành công.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Marie prepared her homework carefully. She could answer all the questions and got good marks.
options: A. Although she prepared her homework carefully, Marie could not answer all the questions and got good marks.
B. Having prepared her homework carefully, Marie could answer all the questions and got good marks.
C. If she had prepared her homework carefully, Marie could have answered all the questions and got good marks.
D. It was because of her careful preparation for the homework, Marie couldn't answer all the questions and got good marks.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: “Having + P.P” = “Because / As a result of having + P.P” → diễn tả nguyên nhân xảy ra trước hành động chính. Dịch nghĩa: Vì đã chuẩn bị bài tập về nhà cẩn thận nên Marie có thể trả lời tất cả các câu hỏi và đạt điểm tốt.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. "You'd better work harder if you don't want to retake the exam!" the teacher said to Jimmy.
options: A. The teacher advised Jimmy to work harder if he didn't want to retake the exam.
B. The teacher ordered Jimmy to work harder if he didn't want to retake the exam.
C. The teacher reminded Jimmy to work harder if he didn't want to retake the exam.
D. The teacher warned Jimmy to work harder if he didn't want to retake the exam.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: “You’d better + V” = “advise + to V”→ cấu trúc lời khuyên. Dịch nghĩa: Giáo viên khuyên Jimmy nên học chăm hơn nếu không muốn thi lại.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. I started writing this essay hours ago and it's still not right.
options: A. I have been writing this essay for hours and it's still not right.
B. It's hours ago since I last wrote this essay correctly.
C. The last time I started writing this essay was hours ago, which is still not right.
D. I didn't stop to write this essay hours ago and it's still not right.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Hành động bắt đầu trong quá khứ và vẫn đang tiếp diễn, dùng Present Perfect Continuous. Dịch nghĩa: Tôi đã viết bài luận này suốt nhiều giờ rồi mà vẫn chưa ổn.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. It's only her second time in an international conference about further education.
options: A. It was the second time she had been in an international conference about further education.
B. She has only been in an international conference about further education once before.
C. She has never been to any international conference about further education before.
D. She has already got used to being in an international conference about further education.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: “It’s only her second time ...” ⟺ “She has only been ... once before.” Dịch nghĩa: Cô ấy mới chỉ tham dự một hội nghị quốc tế về giáo dục nâng cao trước đây mà thôi.
